scope: Editorial structural projection motivated by the printed three-use example; not an automatic source selection algorithm.
occurrenceIDPolicy: primary:L or own-change:L, where L is one-based source line; identical branch text never merges occurrences.
changedScope: Only the changed annotation at an actually moving line; never all six transformed lines as concurrent actors.
desiredKinRole: Caller declares a source kin category; free-text question parsing and automatic use-god choice remain absent.
pairwiseComparisonPolicy: All unordered occurrence pairs retain the five quoted comparisons separately. Applying a two-candidate comparison to each pair is an editorial inspection projection; it does not establish a source total ranking for three uses.
